mathematical_contract.authority: parameter_component_system has one production call into regular implicit-component certification; the global ordered-graph specialization remains the first fast path and the cylindrical cell decomposition is the sole general fallback
mathematical_contract.boundary_coincidence: all four square-edge specializations are classified coefficient-by-coefficient before topology construction; an identically zero specialization is retained as an explicit structural boundary rather than being mislabeled Unsupported
mathematical_contract.smoothness: all solutions of H=H_lifted are enumerated and H_retained is proved nonzero at each; therefore a point where both partial derivatives vanish cannot be admitted as a regular cell
mathematical_contract.events: the decomposition contains every H=H_lifted projection fold, every H=H_retained lifted-direction turn, and every root on each of the four authored square boundaries; exact-equivalent events share one retained fiber and one lifted vertex
mathematical_contract.fiber_isolation: each event receives a disjoint rational lifted neighborhood whose exact retained fiber is proved to contain exactly one distinct root; rational fibers use Hypercurve isolation and algebraic fibers use Hypersolve closed local-field Sturm counting
mathematical_contract.tube_certificate: rational side fibers refine toward each event without a fixed cap until both horizontal tube edges are proved rootless on the open retained interval; this prevents sample roots from being attached to an unrelated component
mathematical_contract.incidence: interior smooth vertices require degree two; square-boundary vertices admit zero, one, or two in-domain incidences; ordered roots outside event tubes retain equal gap rank across a critical fiber
mathematical_contract.cell_transport: tracks are connected by exact event incidence and invariant gap rank, split at every event, and emitted only when both parameter coordinates are strictly monotone; orientation follows exact endpoint order
mathematical_contract.isolated_points: a selected domain event with no in-square incident edge is retained as an exact isolated parameter pair
mathematical_contract.branch_selection: H and the selected-normal branch polynomial are proved to have no common unit-square solution before tracing; one exact sign per track therefore selects or rejects the complete cell without sampling geometry
mathematical_contract.strict: STRICT uses exact specialization, resultants, root isolation, local-field Sturm counts, replay, and unbounded separating refinement
mathematical_contract.approximate_512: APPROXIMATE_512 follows the identical topology proof; only inherited Hyperreal equality terminals may stop at 512 bits, consumption is observed, and no approximate parameter, incidence, orientation, or geometry is synthesized
mathematical_contract.failure_semantics: singular/shared-derivative and boundary-coincident topology remains an explicit boundary; unsupported coefficient towers remain explicit uncertainty
